description: Source code implementing a WGL (Windows OpenGL) surface for DXGI swap chain integration in ANGLE, handling swap chain creation, buffer management, and texture binding for Windows graphics.

classes.name: DXGISwapChainWindowSurfaceWGL
classes.description: Class implementing a WGL surface for DXGI swap chain, managing swap chain lifecycle, buffer registration, and texture binding.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the surface, creates swap chain, and sets up buffers.

methods.name: postSubBuffer
methods.description: Presents a sub-region of the buffer.

methods.name: bindTexImage
methods.description: Binds the swap chain buffer to a texture.

methods.name: isPostSubBufferSupported
methods.description: Checks if post sub-buffer is supported.

methods.name: createDefaultFramebuffer
methods.description: Creates default framebuffer for the surface.

methods.name: setObjectsLocked
methods.description: Locks or unlocks D3D objects for access.

methods.name: createSwapChain
methods.description: Creates the DXGI swap chain for the window.
